I want a small household repair log for me and my partner on our one shared laptop. We rent, and I keep forgetting what we tried when a leak or appliance problem comes back. I want to jot down the date, the problem, what we tried, and whether it helped, then find those notes again.

Keep it usable without internet. No accounts, no cloud sync, no automatic reminders, and no landlord portal. I want a manual JSON export so we can keep our own backup. Photos might help, but I haven't decided whether they belong in the first version. Don't treat that as permission to add them. We should not need to record our address or our landlord's name. I don't want a project-management system.

I'd call the first version useful if we can record three repair attempts and later find the relevant one without reading every entry. I haven't decided what searching or organizing should look like. Keep the first version small, but don't silently drop the limits above.
